items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Yeah, I remember recording with Georgia.

ctx.x: I don't know what that was. It seemed to me it was on a, I believe it was an OK record. Yeah, he was A&R director for OK. I think it was an OK record. Yes. Georgia White. Yeah. Georgia White. Georgia White. Georgia, she was singing and Richard was playing the piano and we had a bass fill. I think Lindsey was on bass and I was playing. I think you went with Sammy Stewart or something. You went away and I think that's when I recorded with them.
Yeah, I remember recording with Georgia. Yeah.

Richard Jones. Richard Jones, we call him Miney Jones. He died of a heart attack, you remember? Yeah. Yeah. Oh, I knew him. Yeah. Oh, I knew him. Oh, I knew him. Yeah. Oh, I knew him. Yeah. Oh, I knew him. Yeah. Oh, I knew him. Yeah. Oh, I knew him. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. and they had a bass fill. I think Lindsey was on bass and I was playing.
